title: Aureline M5 LTS-readiness decision
description: Canonical per-domain record for the LTS-candidate line. Names the resolved LTS decision, whether backport and rollback discipline has been demonstrated on the stable line, the preserved rollback / support evidence snapshot that justified the decision, and the widening stage it authorizes so LTS is never claimed without current rollback and support evidence and never reads as green while refresh or defect-ledger state is stale — LTS stays a checked-in decision packet rather than a marketing label. Downstream release, help, support, shiproom, executive-steering, and program-governance surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's LTS posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
